mindscapeEffects.name: Super Scary Little Tiger
mindscapeEffects.description: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.

mindscapeEffects.name: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
mindscapeEffects.description: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
